content.title: Laundromat Performance | Direct Invite, Machine Proof, Prop Return
content.summary: A dance instructor turns one laundromat task into a compact prop routine. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity, one room and one close camera relationship remain fixed. + A direct invitation precedes the practical prop demonstration. + The machine interaction remains visibly connected to one marked appliance. + Performance uses accounted laundry props and stays physically bounded. + The final frame returns every prop and reconnects performer to the complete room.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one adult dance instructor with a copper bob, mint overalls and one star earring beside a yellow basket in an original teal laundromat. She turns to one marked washer and traces its rotating drum once with her finger. End with both socks returned to the yellow basket and the same instructor framed against the complete washer row.

invariants.rule: One adult identity, one room and one close camera relationship remain fixed.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult identity, one room and one close camera relationship remain fixed."

invariants.rule: A direct invitation precedes the practical prop demonstration.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A direct invitation precedes the practical prop demonstration."

invariants.rule: The machine interaction remains visibly connected to one marked appliance.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The machine interaction remains visibly connected to one marked appliance."

invariants.rule: Performance uses accounted laundry props and stays physically bounded.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Performance uses accounted laundry props and stays physically bounded."

invariants.rule: The final frame returns every prop and reconnects performer to the complete room.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final frame returns every prop and reconnects performer to the complete room."
